act.how: The plan is your revenue calculator from the programme start ({s}). Actuals come from real connections (cost = Activation Key), package activations (cost = price of the country’s token lot used, in the Order Form currency (USD or EUR), × rate when retail is in another currency) and direct subscriptions: revenue after deductions minus the OTA Retained Amount — that is your commission.
calc.sub: Enter your sales and retail prices to see revenue, margin and payback. OTA’s wholesale prices (USD or EUR) are converted at your rate when retail is in another currency.
cx.lot.p: Each paid invoice line is a separate lot with its own price (in the country’s currency) and expiry.
lg.bg.d: Placement Guide of pack v12: public documents and packaging.
lg.bg.title: Where documents are published (Document B)
lg.chg.tax: Changes of tax status are notified to OTA without delay (Master Agreement, clause 2.6); the VAT rate on new invoices changes once the notice is signed.
lg.e.vatregs: Enter ISO country codes separated by commas, or NONE
lg.f.P_BANK_IBAN_EUR: EUR account / IBAN (Approved Countries in Europe)
lg.h.P_BANK_IBAN_EUR: Needed because you have an Order Form in EUR (e.g. Germany). Prices, invoices and commission for that country are in EUR.
lg.h.P_INC_COUNTRY: Partners from any country, including GCC states, can contract. The countries only decide the VAT rate on OTA invoices.
lg.h.P_TAX_COUNTRY: The country where the company is tax resident.
lg.h.P_UAE_FE: An office, branch or other fixed place of business in the UAE.
lg.h.P_VAT_REGS: Tick every country where the company is VAT-registered, or “No VAT registration”.
lg.h.P_VAT_REGS_chg: ISO country codes, comma-separated (e.g. GB, DE), or NONE.
lg.pkg.tplOld: Template texts are still from pack {t}; the signing package must be edition {v}. Wait for the template update.
lg.pub.d2: Documents 07 and 08 are published in the country’s languages: Ukraine — Ukrainian; Kazakhstan — Kazakh and Russian; Germany — German. Until every mandatory language exists, publishing for the country is blocked. First publication is version 1.0.
lg.tp.sub: v12 texts paragraph by paragraph (EN + translations), versions, change classes and releases.
lg.vat.incomplete: Fill in the tax status — the portal then shows which VAT rate applies (0% or 5% UAE).
lg.vat.title: VAT on OTA invoices
onb.b.curD2: OTA invoices are in US dollars, and in euro for Approved Countries in Europe (the Order Form currency). Documents are in English and a second language.
onb.e.uaeFe: Say whether there is a fixed establishment in the UAE
onb.e.vatRegs: Tick the VAT registration countries or “No VAT registration”
onb.f.billingNote: Invoices are issued by OTA TECHNOLOGY DMCC (Dubai) in US dollars, and in euro for Approved Countries in Europe. The VAT rate depends on the tax status below.
onb.f.taxCountryH: The country where the company is tax resident.
onb.f.uaeFeH: An office, branch or other fixed place of business in the UAE.
onb.f.vatRegsH: Tick every country where the company is VAT-registered.
onb.k.ccAvail: {n} tokens and {k} keys on hand for {c}
ops.inv.vat0: VAT 0% — zero-rated export of services; the VAT amount in AED uses the UAE Central Bank rate on the invoice date, stored with the invoice. Country: {cc}. Keys and tokens are issued only after the payment mark.
ops.inv.vat5: UAE VAT 5%: the Partner is resident, VAT-registered or has a fixed establishment in the UAE (Master Agreement, clause 2.6). The VAT amount in AED uses the UAE Central Bank rate for the invoice currency on its date. Country: {cc}.
ops.rs.aNote: Gross payments are in {c} at the acquirer’s rate. The statement is not a tax invoice and does not set off any payment.
ord.b.emptyP: A batch appears once OTA receives payment for keys: the keys are issued and the same number of SIM cards waits for shipment.
ord.cy.ccyH: USD; EUR for countries in Europe (Master Agreement, clause 8.1). Applies to the country’s prices, invoices, statements and commission.
ord.cy.ccyLocked: Can’t be changed: the country already has invoices or statements.
ord.cy.ossE: Format: EU + 9 digits, or an EU VAT number
ord.cy.ossH: One-Stop-Shop number for VAT on Direct Subscriptions (DE Order Form, 1.6). Empty = not printed.
ord.d.sims: Together with the keys: {n} for {c} in custody (free of charge, one batch).
ord.doc.terms: Payment terms: 100% prepayment by bank transfer in the invoice currency ({c}); keys and tokens are issued after payment. The payer’s bank charges are borne by the payer. Please quote the invoice number.
ord.f.ccy: Prices and invoices for {c} are in {k} (the Order Form currency).
ord.f.fromD: Tax Invoice in the Order Form currency (USD / EUR) · TRN {trn}
ord.f.keys.sim: For each key bought for {c}, OTA provides one SIM card for that country in custody, free of charge. Keys and SIM cards are shown as one batch; SIM cards are not sold.
ord.fx.note: Maintained by OTA Finance. Every invoice and credit note shows the VAT amount in AED at the rate of its currency (USD or EUR) on its date; the rate is stored with the document and never changes afterwards.
ord.fx.title: UAE Central Bank rates (USD / EUR → AED)
ord.howItWorks: A device needs one Activation Key for life and one Service Token per package. Both are issued automatically once OTA receives the payment. For every key bought, OTA ships one SIM card for the same country in custody, free of charge — keys and SIM cards form one batch (see “SIM shipments”).
ord.inv.sub: Tax Invoices from OTA TECHNOLOGY DMCC in the Order Form currency (USD, or EUR for countries in Europe), and credit notes.
ord.q.act: Activated with a key: {a} of {s} delivered ({p})
ord.q.aria: {a} of {s} delivered SIM cards activated with a key, {p}
ord.q.buyFirst: Buy keys for this country first — SIM cards are provided for them.
ord.q.first: No SIM cards delivered yet — a shipment can go right away.
ord.q.p: Each batch is the keys bought for a country plus the same number of SIM cards in custody. A further shipment within that quantity follows once at least {p}% of the SIM cards previously delivered for that country are activated.
ord.q.title: Activation Keys and SIM cards 1:1
ord.sh.e.70: Fewer than {r}% of previously delivered SIM cards are activated — tick OTA’s agreement or wait.
ord.sh.e.ovNote: Enter the reason for the exception
ord.sh.e.quota: At most {n} SIM cards can be shipped (still due for the keys bought).
ord.sh.how: SIM cards are shipped within the number of keys bought for the country, in one or several shipments. A further shipment is made once at least 70% of the SIM cards previously delivered for that country are activated. Each shipment has a customs pro forma (OTA-PF) and a receipt & custody acknowledgment (OTA-SR) with the same number; after delivery, confirm quantity and condition.
ord.sh.ovH: Master Agreement, clause 8.1: “unless OTA agrees otherwise”. The reason is kept in the audit log.
ord.sh.q.70: {a} of {s} previously delivered SIM cards are activated with a key ({p}; SIM cards in transit are not counted). A further shipment needs {r}%: {n} more activations, unless OTA agrees otherwise.
ord.sh.q.full: All {k} SIM cards for the keys bought for {c} have already been shipped.
ord.sh.q.noKeys: There are no paid keys for {c} yet — SIM cards are provided only for keys bought.
ord.sh.q.ok: Up to {n} SIM cards can be shipped for {c}.
ord.sh.qtyH: No more than is still due for the keys bought for the country.
ord.sh.ruleTxt: At creation: {k} keys bought, {b} delivered before, {a} activated with a key ({p}).
ord.sub: Activation Keys and Service Tokens you buy from OTA. Invoices are in each country’s Order Form currency: USD, or EUR for countries in Europe.
ord.sum.vat0d: Zero-rated export of services from the UAE.
ord.sum.vat5d: You are resident, VAT-registered or have a fixed establishment in the UAE — OTA charges UAE VAT at 5% (Master Agreement, clause 2.6).
own.cb.qPh: Code (12 or 16 characters) or serial number (12 digits or 5 characters)
prc.keyText: Licence key for the CONNECT program — one per device, for life. For each key bought, OTA provides one SIM card for that country in custody, free of charge — keys and SIM cards are shown as one batch.
prc.sub: Your current OTA price list for each country: Activation Keys, Service Tokens and direct subscription terms. All net, in the country’s Order Form currency (USD; EUR for countries in Europe).
prn.ap.p: Once approved, all print materials are built from this version. The previous approved version is superseded; released runs do not change.
prn.bl.batchP: All non-activated codes of the batch stop working and their Activation Keys are freed. This cannot be undone.
prn.bl.e.range: Check the numbers: “to” must not be below “from”
prn.bl.p: Loss or theft: by serial number, by range, or the whole batch (button on the batch page). Activated codes do not change.
prn.bl.title: Block cards
prn.bst.closed.d: All codes activated, blocked or expired.
prn.bst.exported.d: The serial;code;deadline file was issued once.
prn.bst.printed.d: The run was received — codes can be activated.
prn.bt.codesNote: The full code exists only in the variable-print file; here you see the last 4 characters.
prn.bt.dlBad: The deadline must be after the print date.
prn.bt.dlMax: No later than print date + 36 months.
prn.bt.dlPast: The deadline is already in the past — pick a date no earlier than {d}.
prn.bt.dlSoon: The deadline is less than a month away — the cards may not sell in time. Press “Generate codes” again to confirm.
prn.bt.emptyP: Create a batch for a plan and country — codes are generated from your Activation Keys for that country.
prn.bt.keysShort: Free keys for this country: {n}. Lower the quantity or buy more keys.
prn.bt.noBrand: No approved brand profile — a batch cannot be created.
prn.bt.note: Each code in a batch reserves one Activation Key of the plan’s country. On activation the key is used (new device) or the reservation is released; blocked and expired codes free the key. Only a code in status “Printed” can be activated.
prn.bt.runH: The static back PDF these codes are printed with.
prn.bt.runReq: First release the B2 back for this country (Print materials → Layouts).
prn.bt.sub: Package codes for print: serial numbers, activation deadline, variable-print file, blocking.
prn.bt.title: Card batches
prn.ck.noFont: the Inter font did not load; measured with the fallback font
prn.ck.noneP: Run the checks — it takes a few seconds.
prn.ck.relFail: Release was blocked by these checks:
prn.ck.stale: Results are out of date: the profile or template changed. Run the checks again.
prn.ck.stressP: SUPERBRAND AUTO / connect.superbrand-auto.com, 6 : 1 and 1 : 1 logos; plus max lengths (20-character name, 30-character domain); all card and sleeve languages.
prn.ck.what: Before release the portal renders every layout and checks: block overflow, the stress set, QR (decoded back), trim and field sizes ±0.1 mm, minimum type size, logo, accent contrast, unapproved wording. Any failure blocks the release of that material.
prn.ck.wtaFound: the layout contains “[wording to be approved]”
prn.dl.againP: OTA decision: the file was issued before. The re-issue is logged with the reason.
prn.dl.demo: Demo: file encryption and the one-time link / SFTP are simulated; a CSV is downloaded.
prn.dl.done: File of batch {n} issued and logged
prn.dl.e.again: Re-issue: OTA only, with a reason
prn.dl.fmt: Format: serial;code;deadline (UTF-8, “;” separator). Code in groups of 4.
prn.dl.none: The file has not been issued yet.
prn.dl.onlyOta: The file was already issued. A re-issue is an OTA decision only.
prn.dl.p: The file is issued once and logged. A re-issue needs an OTA decision with a reason.
prn.f.accentH: Contrast with white {r} : 1 (needs ≥ 4.5). Only “CONNECT”, the term and step numbers.
prn.f.brandH: 2–20 characters: Latin, Cyrillic, digits, space, hyphen. The programme is “brandName CONNECT”.
prn.f.cmykH: From HEX: {c}. Take the exact value from your brand book.
prn.f.ctyH: Scratch-card languages follow the Order Form country (UA — Ukrainian, KZ — Kazakh + Russian). The sleeve has one language per country run.
prn.f.logoH: Vector SVG, transparent background, trimmed to the outline, one colour. PDF/EPS are converted to SVG on the server (coming later).
prn.f.shortH: Needed when the domain is longer than 24 characters (sleeve and SIM carrier).
prn.lb.draft: The brand profile is not approved yet — labels use the current draft.
prn.lb.more: And {n} more sheets — all are printed.
prn.lb.note: Country of origin and seal number are not stored on the shipment record yet — the label keeps fill-in fields. The QR on A2 leads to the ICCID list in the console (login required).
prn.lb.sub: A1 — pack label, A2 — carton label. A4, office printer, b/w.
prn.lb.title: Shipment labels
prn.lc.notsvg: This is not an SVG file.
prn.lc.parse: The SVG file cannot be read.
prn.lc.raster: The logo contains a raster image — a clean vector is needed.
prn.lc.size: The SVG has no viewBox or size.
prn.lr.ratio: Ratio {r} : 1 — fitted into the field, left-aligned
prn.lr.wordmark: Lettering height in the C2 field (7.5 mm): ≈ {mm} mm (needs ≥ 1.2 mm)

prn.m.b2Note: Only the code is printed under the scratch layer, as text (no QR). Code, serial number and activation deadline are variable print from the batch file.
prn.m.kzNote: The reference bilingual KZ back does not fit 85.6 × 54 mm at 6 pt (the reference PNG is cut off at the bottom). Here the KZ / RU steps sit side by side; the texts are verbatim from the template.
prn.m.noPlan: No active plan for this country
prn.m.pdfNote: Print / PDF here is the browser’s, at physical size. The production PDF/X with embedded fonts, CMYK and the CutContour spot colour is made server-side (coming later).
prn.m.scratched: Show the code under the layer (sample)
prn.m.spec: Trim {w} × {h} mm + 2 mm bleed each side
prn.m.spec0: Sheet for the partner and the printer (screen / PDF)
prn.m.stressNote: Stress set (spec 7.2.2): SUPERBRAND AUTO, connect.superbrand-auto.com, wide (6 : 1) and square logos, languages de and kk. DE card wording is not approved yet.
prn.m.wm: logo lettering in the C2 field ≈ {mm} mm
prn.m.wta: There is no approved card wording for this country — the layout shows “[wording to be approved]”. Release is blocked until the wording is approved.
prn.m.zones: Show zones (blue — partner modules, pink — die line)
prn.n.approved: Approved {d} · {by}. To change anything, create a new version — released runs stay as they are.
prn.n.otaReview: The partner submitted the brand profile. Check the logo, colour and domain, then approve or return it with a reason.
prn.n.readOnly: The partner admin can edit the brand profile.
prn.n.rejected: OTA returned the profile: {r}. Create a new version and fix it.
prn.n.submitted: The profile is in OTA review. Until it is approved, the previous approved version is used for print.
prn.na.p: Print materials are visible to the partner’s admin, signatory and operations, and to OTA.
prn.pl.emptyP: Add a plan: name on the card, SKU, OTA package, term and country.
prn.pl.lock: This plan already has card batches — only “Active” can change. For another name or term, create a new plan.
prn.pl.name: Name on the card
prn.pl.nameH: Up to 30 characters, up to 2 lines on the card.
prn.pl.note: Light / Standard / Premium is OTA’s internal classification and is never printed. The card shows your plan name; the SKU is for your systems and reports and is not printed. Each name is a separate card run.
prn.pl.pkgH: Must match the plan of the device models the cards are used on.
prn.pl.title: Partner plans (PartnerPlan)
prn.pr.done: Printed: {n} codes can now be activated
prn.pr.p: Batch {n}: {q} cards received from the printer. After confirmation the codes can be activated.
prn.prevNote: Scaled down. Physical size and all layouts are on the Layouts tab.

prn.rl.emptyP: Open a layout and press “Release” once the profile is approved and the checks pass.
prn.rl.note: Number OTA-{code}-PRN-{type}-{NNN}-v{N}. NNN is the material (type, country, language, plan), vN a new version after a profile or template change. Released runs never change.
prn.rl.title: Material releases
prn.run.frozen: The release is immutable: the layout is built from the profile snapshot taken at release.

prn.t.rejected: Brand profile v{n} returned to the partner

prn.t.submitted: Brand profile v{n} submitted to OTA
prn.title: Print materials
prn.v.contrast: Contrast with white is {r} : 1 — at least 4.5 : 1 is needed. Pick a darker colour.
prn.v.domain30: The domain has {n} characters — the card fits up to 30. A shorter subdomain is needed.
prn.v.nameChars: Only Latin, Cyrillic, digits, space and hyphen.
prn.v.phone: Enter the support phone for this country.
prn.v.plan2: On the card the name would take more than 2 lines. Shorten it.
prn.v.short24: The domain has {n} characters and the sleeve fits 24. Enter a short subdomain.
prn.v.shortBad: Short subdomain: up to 24 characters, no spaces.
prn.v.skuChars: Only Latin letters, digits, dot, hyphen, underscore.
prn.w.colors: The logo has {n} colours — print needs one.
prn.w.ink: The text colour has contrast {r} : 1 — a darker one is advised (≥ 7 : 1).
prn.w.noText: The SVG has no text elements. If the lettering is drawn as curves, its height in the C2 field (7.5 mm) must be ≥ 1.2 mm — OTA checks this.
prn.w.wordmark: The logo lettering on the sleeve (7.5 mm field) would be ≈ {mm} mm — below 1.2 mm. OTA decides.
